_about: Ryan's picks, each source render kept beside this file at full size for later fixes. The first pass is of 9 October; on 13 October he picked the wildlife again from the battle-pose takes (the original sets retired) and changed four heroes. role: sprite (cut into art/foes at its frame), chibi (a hero's sprite for its domain's final, cut at 36x48), promoted (the boss register for the hero's promoted form, waiting on its entry). prompt is what rendered it; candidate is the seed, which in a takes set is also the take's number in design.variants. cut is the cutter's options that pick needed (--tol 90 for a grey ground shadow, --holes N for background pockets of at least N render pixels, --glow for a coloured glow). note is Ryan's phone note on the pick, verbatim: what to fix. marked holds candidates he set aside for another use, with his note.
